scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w api" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w ai360-mcp
scripts.build:mcp: npm run build -w ai360-mcp && npm run build -w ai360-rules-mcp
scripts.build:pages: node scripts/write-web-env.mjs && npm run build -w web -- --configuration=github-pages && node scripts/prepare-github-pages.mjs
